name: Quillwood Notes
tagline: A fictional blog of small-town stories
description: Quillwood Notes is a fictional blog. Every post, person, place and organisation on it is invented.

sections.name: World
sections.description: Posts about faraway places, borders, rivers and the people who argue over them.

sections.name: Politics
sections.description: Notes on councils, votes and the people in charge of the made-up town of Halden.

sections.name: Business
sections.description: Shops, bakeries, freight yards and the money that moves between them.

sections.name: Money
sections.description: Imaginary indexes, invented interest rates and what they might mean for your wallet.

sections.name: Technology
sections.description: Gadgets, apps, batteries and practical how-tos.

sections.name: Science
sections.description: Coral reefs, asteroids and other things that are bigger than us.

sections.name: Health
sections.description: Flu seasons, hospital rotas and looking after yourself.

sections.name: Sport
sections.description: Football, running and the rest of the sporting week in a town that doesn’t exist.

sections.name: Essays
sections.description: Longer personal essays and arguments from the blog’s writers.
